purpose: The service handles posting, reading, and correcting entries in a ledger system, moving from the monolith to a separate service.

components.name: ledger-core
components.evidence: The ledger moves out of the monolith into its own service, ledger-core.

components.name: ledger-db
components.evidence: ledger-core writes the entries and balances to ledger-db (PostgreSQL)

components.name: ledger-events
components.evidence: ledger-core publishes every posted entry to ledger-events (Kafka)
